race.comment: LIMBERING (10) raced on the speed and kept going to score by 2 lengths last time out over 1400m at Balaklava. Drawn to enjoy a good run on the speed and gets in nicely after the claim. ATTAIN (1) tackled city class last start when 10th over 1400m at Morphettville Parks. This is much more to his liking and if he can repeat the run two back - when beaten just over two lengths in BM66 grade - he goes close. BOW RIBBON (8) got back into the placings last start when dropping back to 1400m, the trip he stays at here and draws beautifully in gate 1. PHOEBE BUFFAY (6) hasn't made an impression lately despite market confidence. Last start could only manage sixth over 1400m at this track. Can improve and is worth including now at peak fitness FLIGHT DECK (14) missed the placings when resuming two runs back then was never in contention last start when 6 lengths away in ninth over 1400m at Morphettville Parks. Better suited at this level and can improve.
